name: Liferun
verdict: The biggest movement is a 57.89% drop in leads over the last 7 days alongside a 38.3% rise in CPL, likely driven by channel disruptions flagged across Meta and Google (both showing dark periods and a zero-spend day), which cut active delivery. Over 28 days, Meta carried all 117 leads at a $16.85 CPL on $1,971.56 total spend, while Google Ads consumed $467.15 with 0 conversions, and GHL recorded 181 contacts and 151 opportunities against Windsor's 117 leads — both figures are active but unreconciled.

performance.verdict: Both channels dark 2 days; 5 overdue SOW milestones compounding delivery risk.

findings.text: Zero spend on Sep 17–18 (both Meta and Google dark) halted all lead flow; zero leads confirmed those 2 days.
5 SOW milestones overdue since Jul 20–Aug 31: Stripe QA, GHL build gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unconfirmed complete.
CPL rose 38.3% week-over-week; 3-day lead signal (Sep 14–16: 12 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 16–18: 4 leads) confirms sharp mid-week collapse.
Google Ads spent $467.15 over 28 days with 0 conversions and only 97 clicks — no results attributable to this channel at all.
GHL shows 181 contacts vs 117 Meta leads and 151 opportunities with 0 won — a 64-contact gap suggests intake leak, not an ads sourcing problem.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta + Google delivery; both channels showed $0 spend Sep 17–18 with zero leads.
suggestions.monday_update: Both Meta and Google recorded $0 spend on Sep 17 and Sep 18, confirmed by the daily series — all lead flow stopped. Check for payment method failures, policy holds, or campaign pauses across both accounts and restore delivery today. Success is confirmed when spend returns to the 7-day average of ~$47.50/day and leads resume at ≥4/day. Re-check by Sep 22.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads or redirect its budget: $467.15 spent over 28 days with 0 conversions and 97 clicks.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has consumed $467.15 across the 28-day window with zero recorded conversions and only 97 clicks — no attributable result of any kind. Shift this daily budget (~$16/day) to Meta, where all 117 leads originated at a $16.85 CPL. Success is confirmed if Meta CPL holds at or below $16.85 within 7 days of the shift. Sohib to approve before any change executes.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake path: 181 contacts vs 117 leads and 0 won opportunities signals a CRM intake leak.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 181 contacts against 117 Meta-sourced leads and 151 opportunities with 0 won — the 64-contact gap and zero wins point to a pipeline intake or field-mapping failure, not an ads problem. This connects directly to the overdue BWS duplicate-check and Becklar billing verification milestones (due Aug 31). Nacer to run one live order through each intake path and confirm exactly one fully mapped opportunity per order. Success is a clean end-to-end trace with zero duplicates by Sep 26.
